findings.pattern: quick filters used generic action labels that did not disclose their actual filter
findings.semanticTest: Each button maps to a data-hero action; before the rewrite, 'Find support' applied the startup audience filter and 'Kazakhstan support' combined format and region filters.
findings.replacement: Retained the real AVDS button group, renamed every action to its concrete outcome, and verified the startup action produces the active startup state and two matching cards.

findings.pattern: all topic chips appeared before the first result although topic is an optional refinement
findings.semanticTest: Topic is a real taxonomy filter, but it is not required to begin a search and its chip row displaced the first results.
findings.replacement: Moved the unchanged taxonomy control into the accessible Topic disclosure, preserving its labelled group and direct button behaviour.
